title: PNAS 2017 reduction validation record (v0)
description: One record per candidate reduction. Freezes the classification, mapping, assumptions, observables, accounting, error metrics, pre-registration, and status defined in docs/reduction/reduction_validation_protocol_v0.md. Field names are fixed; values may be null only where the protocol marks them optional for the chosen reduction_class.

reduction_class.description: Primary class from protocol section 1. Classes A/B are exact; C-G are representational or approximate. Every record also carries an observable set (class H) via the observables/accounting_variables fields.

exactness.description: Derived from reduction_class but recorded explicitly so a reader cannot misclassify.

source_model.description: Path or id of the immutable model this reduction is derived from, e.g. models/pnas2017_full_reference/original/fMGG_synthesis.xml.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 over raw source-model bytes; must match data/provenance.csv.

source_reaction_ids.description: Source reaction ids consumed/rewritten by the reduction.

reduced_states.description: State coordinates retained in the reduced representation.

eliminated_states.description: States removed from the explicit state vector (may be reconstructed).

reconstructed_states.description: States recovered from the reduced state via an explicit reconstruction/algebraic map. Empty if elimination is irreversible.

reconstruction_map.description: Explicit x = R(y, c) map or invariant basis (required non-null for classes B, C, D, E).

net_stoichiometry.description: For pathway lumping (G/A4): the derived net species->coefficient map, e.g. {"ATP":-1,"AMP":1,"PPi":1,...}.

cancelled_intermediates.description: Intermediates that cancel to zero net stoichiometry in a derived pathway.

observables.description: Class H. The reduction is valid ONLY relative to these.

unrecoverable_observables.description: Microstate observables destroyed by the reduction (required for C, D, G).

accounting_variables.description: Ledger quantities that must be preserved (e.g. ATP, AMP, PPi, free tRNA, aminoacyl-tRNA, particle-number proxy).

assumptions.description: Every analytic assumption, stated. Empty array asserts exactness.

mathematical_identity_or_approximation.description: The precise identity or approximation claimed, in symbols/prose.

validity_domain.description: Declared domain of validity (state ranges, parameter regime, time window).

failure_domain.description: Where the reduction is known/expected to break (at least one negative or stress test is required for an approximate certificate).

initialization_rule.description: How reduced/invariant initial conditions are derived from the full model (no clipping/projection).

solver_settings.description: Solver, tolerances, time window, output grid, seed. Recorded for reproducibility.

metrics.description: Error metrics computed (e.g. E_inf, integrated_abs, endpoint_rel, peak_time, flux, cumulative_extent).

thresholds.description: Per-tier acceptance thresholds frozen before any reduced result is seen.

timescale_evidence.description: For D/E: fast & slow state lists, tau_fast, tau_slow, epsilon (structural modes excluded), moving-manifold residual. Report-only unless a manifold exists.

preregistration_commit_or_hash.description: Commit or content hash the thresholds/equations were frozen at. Null only before PREREGISTERED.

human_decision_required.description: True if any scientific judgment the protocol reserves for a human is unresolved.

status_scope_note.description: Mandatory scope sentence; 'validated' may never appear without its class/domain scope.

forbidden_claim_audit.description: Which of the protocol section-5 forbidden claims were explicitly checked and NOT assumed.
